evidence.note: ReCo uses a 30M process-reward estimator to set, per reasoning step, both the KV-cache retention ratio and generation-side controls (a reflection-token logit penalty and confidence-based early stopping), cutting generated tokens by 37-65% and end-to-end latency by 2.08-2.35x versus full-cache CoT.
evidence.title: Fewer Tokens, Smaller Cache: Reward-Coordinated Efficient Reasoning

evidence.note: RECAP mitigates the general-capability forgetting (perception, grounding, safety) that RLVR-based reasoning fine-tuning causes in vision-language models, by replaying general-domain data alongside the reasoning objective and dynamically reweighting each objective's loss based on its recent convergence rate and instability -- an entropy-regularized priority allocation that provably reduces to a closed-form softmax -- preserving or improving general capabilities while matching or exceeding reasoning-only fine-tuning's math/reasoning performance, and, as a side effect, producing shorter, more concise reasoning rationales without compromising reasoning ability.
evidence.title: Beyond Reasoning Gains: Mitigating General-Capability Forgetting in Large Reasoning Models
